ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, mostly dark green curly-edged leaves with some lighter green and ruffled edges, covering roughly 35% of the plate in a loose mound centered left of the plate, wilted and slightly glossy with moisture, leaves about 3-8 cm long, sitting directly on the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green shredded strands, finely julienned and tangled, clustered in the center of the leafy mound, slightly limp with a fibrous texture, about 5 cm across | 15
ITEM 3 | Scattered small orange-red shreds, thin strips about 1-2 cm long, sparse and dispersed among the greens, with slightly firm texture | 5
ITEM 4 | Dark brown thin strips, slender and slightly curled, scattered within the greens and along the lower edge of the mound, about 3-4 cm long, slightly glossy | 4
ITEM 5 | Light brown dressing residue, small smears and specks dotted around the rim and right side of the plate, thin and matte, covering under 5% of the plate surface | 3
